title: Plan Terms, Coverage Start and Eligible Vehicles: Road Hazard Protection
content:
Every Road Hazard Protection plan is sold only for a Crestline tire set in status ordered or active, and only for the vehicle classes and use the plan lists. Coverage starts on tire installation, runs for the plan term in calendar months, and ends for a tire whose tread has worn down to the plan's coverage limit.

The six Road Hazard Protection plans, from rank 1 to rank 6, are the Crestline Road Hazard 12-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 24-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Plus 36-Month Protection, the Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection and the Crestline Road Hazard Commercial LT Protection; the columns below use the short names 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month, Plus 36, Life-of-Tread and Commercial LT.

| | 12-Month | 24-Month | 36-Month | Plus 36 | Life-of-Tread | Commercial LT |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Eligible vehicle classes | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan, light truck | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan, light truck | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan, light truck | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan, light truck | passenger car, SUV/CUV, minivan | light truck, commercial van, SUV/CUV |
| Usage class sold for | personal | personal | personal | personal | personal | commercial |
| Plan term, calendar months | 12 | 24 | 36 | 36 | 72 | 24 |
| Tread depth at or below which a tire is no longer covered | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 2/32 inch | 3/32 inch |
| Event that starts coverage | tire installation | tire installation | tire installation | tire installation | tire installation | tire installation |
| Covers damage on a vehicle in commercial use | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Transferable to a new owner of the vehicle | no | no | no | no | no | no |

**Reading the term.** The plan term is counted in calendar months from the date coverage starts. The Life-of-Tread plan runs until the tire reaches its coverage tread limit of 2/32 inch or for 72 months, whichever comes first. On every plan a tire whose measured tread is at or below the plan's limit is no longer covered: 2/32 inch on the five consumer plans, 3/32 inch on the Commercial LT plan.

**Points of judgement.**
- A pickup in personal use may be covered by the 12-Month, 24-Month, 36-Month or Plus 36 plan, or by the Commercial LT plan when it is in commercial use, but not by the Life-of-Tread plan, whose class list does not include light trucks.
- A commercial van appears only in the Commercial LT plan's class list.
- No plan follows the vehicle to a new owner.
